units.title: SafetyInterlockService
units.text: SafetyInterlockService.rejectMotion(command) returns INTERLOCK_OPEN when either bumperLoopClosed or gateLoopClosed is false; no motion command is forwarded to the drive controller.

units.title: Charging-bay departure
units.text: Before a robot leaves a charging bay, its battery state of charge must be at least 35 %, the safety gate must be closed, and the route reservation must be active.

units.title: Emergency-stop recovery
units.text: After an emergency stop, the operator inspects the aisle, clears the stop condition, acknowledges the safety event, and then requests a controlled restart from the fleet console.

units.title: Geofence
units.text: A geofence is a virtual boundary that constrains where a mobile robot may travel or perform an action.

units.title: Robot state action matrix
units.text: State: MANUAL_RECOVERY | Allowed action: low-speed jog | Remote autonomous mission: prohibited.

units.title: Safety event record
units.text: A safety event record stores the robot identifier, event code, controller timestamp, operator acknowledgement, and restart authorization.
